title: Sidang Di Miyup Gelombang .
intro: Sidroe nabi, nyang teubeuban ngon misi gobnyan, geupeugot saboh keuputosan nyang geupeujiôh gobnyan nibak umat gobnyan dan u dalam ujian nyang hana teuduga. Perjalanan gobnyan meuubah jeuet keu dramatis, geu-uji iman dan kesabaran gobnyan deungon cara nyang paleng dalam. Jeuet gata simpulkan detail keujadian luar biasa nyoe dari petunjuk nyang ka geubri?
clues: Sidroe nabi geukirém ubak saboh bansa, teuma geujak deungon bagah-bagah, geurasa frustrasi deungon peunulakan awaknyan.
Peujalanan gobnyan geujak u la'ôt, disinan gobnyan geuék kapai nyang brat that geumita jalan.
Saboh badai raya teuka, mengancam kapai, dan keputusan dipeugot untuk dipeutron sidroe ureung u laot untuk dipeuringan beban, dipeuteunte deungon undian.
Gobnyan geuteubiet lé makhlok nyang dalam, saboh keujadian ajaéb nyang geupeuteutab lé keuheundak Ilahi.
Lam bataih pruet makhluk nyan, gobnyan geumeuhôi bak Po geuh, geutaubat ngön geupeumulia Allah lam seupôt.
Lheueh masa doá nyang that-that, gobnyan geubôh u ateueh panté nyang hana meu-ulang-ulang, leumoh teuma udeb, dan lheuehnyan geugisa dan geuteumeung umat gobnyan akhéjih ka meuiman.

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Saboh janji barô deungon umat manusia .
Saboh lahe nyang ajaéb keu umat Gobnyan .
Saboh keurajeuen nyang geupeudong keu keuturonan gobnyan .
Saboh keumbalian keu umat Gobnyan nyang lheueh nyan meuiman .
Saboh keumeunangan ateuh sidroe peunguasa nyang tirani .
outcome.answer: Saboh keumbalian keu umat Gobnyan nyang lheueh nyan meuiman .

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
